title: Delete Greatest Value in Each Row
summary: Given an m x n matrix of positive integers, repeatedly delete the greatest value in each row, add the maximum of these deleted values to the answer, and continue until the grid is empty.
statement: Given an m x n matrix of positive integers, repeatedly delete the greatest value in each row, add the maximum of these deleted values to the answer, and continue until the grid is empty. The number of columns decreases with each operation.
constraints: In each round remove the greatest remaining value from every row.
Add the greatest value removed in that round to the score.
Continue until the rectangular grid is empty.
hints: Sort each row in increasing order.
The original repeated-max removals correspond to reading sorted rows from right to left.
For each aligned sorted column, add its maximum; column order does not affect the sum.
Sorting fixes every row’s removal sequence, and each zipped column contains exactly one round’s removed values.
editorial: Sorting fixes every row’s removal sequence, and each zipped column contains exactly one round’s removed values.

tests.explanation: Round maxima contribute four, three, and one, totaling eight.
The only removed value is ten, so the score is ten.
